summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K attaching its Annual Report for fiscal year 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation filing. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics involved. The filing simply satisfies the registrant's ongoing reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. As a standard annual report submission, it does not trigger any special-situations classification or risk-arb interest.
